sections.label: Cruise economic regulatory role transfer
sections.summary: The economic regulatory role for the cruise industry is transferred from MPA to STB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: First, the transfer of economic regulatory role for the cruise industry from MPA to STB.

sections.label: Passenger throughput growth 2012-2019
sections.summary: From 2012 to 2019, overall passenger throughput grew at a CAGR of 10.3% to reach 1.82 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: From 2012 to 2019, overall passenger throughout has grown at a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.3% to reach 1.82 million.

sections.label: Regional cruise capacity and STB powers
sections.summary: Regional cruise capacity is projected to more than double from 3.4 million in 2022 to 7.3 million by 2027, and STB needs regulatory powers for service standards, berth use and pricing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Cruise capacity in the region is projected to more than double from 3.4 million in 2022 to 7.3 million passengers by 2027.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To ensure that these terminals are operated in a manner that is aligned with our broader goals of developing Singapore's cruise and tourism activities, STB will need regulatory powers to ensure high service standards, optimise the use of the limited number of berths and prevent excessive pricing.

sections.label: Information protection and STB enforcement powers
sections.summary: Clause 21 includes a preservation of secrecy provision, and the Bill expands STB's administrative and enforcement powers over tourist guides and cruise terminal licensees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Examples of such information would be visitorship numbers and tourism receipts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To protect the information that has been collected, clause 21 also includes a “preservation of secrecy” provision to limit the onward disclosure of such information.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Fifth, this Bill expands STB’s administrative and enforcement powers, including according appropriate penalties, to regulate tourist guides and the cruise terminal licensees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This is necessary for STB to exercise its regulatory functions effectively.

sections.label: STB third-party guarantor power
sections.summary: The section introduces a new power for STB to act as a third-party guarantor for tourism enterprises, subject to the Minister's approval and conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The section introduces a new power for STB to act as a third-party guarantor for the tourism enterprises.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This is subject to the Minister’s approval and provided that the enterprise develops Singapore as a destination or enhances the travel and tourism sector’s contribution to the economy.

sections.label: Interpreting public interest in Act
sections.summary: A question asks how 'public interest' should be interpreted in the context of the Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Given the scope of matters that can fall under “public interest” is very broad and that it is a new term in the context of the Act in relation to important decisions, can Minister share how “public interest” should be interpreted in the context of the Act?

sections.label: STB acting as guarantor
sections.summary: STB may rarely act as a guarantor when there are strong and clear benefits to the economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On rare occasions, STB may opt to exercise the power to act as a guarantor if there are strong and clear benefits to the economy.

sections.label: Global cruise industry investment
sections.summary: The global cruise industry is under 1% of the global maritime industry but leads in innovative technologies, investing over US$26 billion in new ships.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Despite comprising less than 1% of the global maritime industry, the global cruise industry is at the forefront of developing innovative technologies and has invested more than US$26 billion in new ships with energy efficient technologies and cleaner fuels.

sections.label: CLIA fleet emissions targets
sections.summary: CLIA's global fleet of cruise lines aims for net-zero carbon cruising by 2050 and a 40% carbon emissions rate reduction by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: CLIA’s global fleet of cruise lines aim to achieve net-zero carbon cruising by 2050 and reduce the rate of carbon emissions by 40% by 2030.
